# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This project keeps its coding standards in `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root.
Read that file for conventions, patterns, and workspace boundaries.

Each workspace under `apps/` and `packages/` has its own `CLAUDE.md` with the
facts specific to it. Read the one for the workspace you are editing.

See `docs/architecture.md` for the monorepo map and for deciding where new code
belongs.
